ICICIBANK.d: ICICI Bank offers a wide range of banking and financial products including retail and corporate loans, trade finance, and insurance. It is one of India's largest private sector banks.

ICICILIFE.d: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company provides a range of life insurance, pension, and health insurance products. It serves individual and corporate customers across India.

ICIL.d: Indo Count Industries manufactures and exports bed linen, cotton yarn, and home textile products. Its primary end markets are international retail brands and major home fashion distributors.

IDBI.d: The bank offers a comprehensive range of commercial and retail banking products and services across India. It is categorized as a private sector bank with majority government ownership.

IDEA.d: Vodafone Idea Limited provides cellular and fixed-line telecom services to retail and enterprise customers across India. It is one of the country's major private telecom operators.

IDFCFIRSTB.d: IDFC First Bank Limited provides retail banking, wholesale banking, and financial services. It caters to individuals, small businesses, and corporations.

IEX.d: Indian Energy Exchange operates an electronic platform for trading electricity, renewable energy certificates, and energy saving certificates. Its customers include power generators, distribution companies, and industrial consumers.

IFCI.d: IFCI Limited provides financial products and advisory services to industrial and infrastructure projects. Established as a government-backed development finance institution, it serves corporate borrowers across India.

IGL.d: Indraprastha Gas Limited supplies compressed natural gas and piped natural gas to households, commercial establishments, and transport sectors in Delhi and surrounding regions. It operates as a joint venture involving GAIL and BPCL.

IIFL.d: IIFL Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company offering home loans, gold loans, and business loans. It primarily serves underbanked retail customers and micro, small, and medium enterprises across India.

IIFLCAPS.d: IIFL Capital Services offers investment banking, institutional equities, stockbroking, and financial advisory services. Its clients include corporate entities, institutional investors, high-net-worth individuals, and retail investors.

IMFA.d: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited produces ferrochrome and generates captive power. It is a fully integrated producer serving domestic and international stainless steel manufacturers.

INDGN.d: Indegene Limited provides digital services, commercial solutions, and medical expertise to pharmaceutical, emerging biotech, and medical device companies globally.

INDHOTEL.d: The Indian Hotels Company Limited owns and operates hotels, resorts, and palaces, primarily under the Taj brand. It serves leisure and business travelers globally, acting as India's largest hospitality company by market capitalization.

INDIAMART.d: Indiamart Intermesh operates an online business-to-business marketplace connecting buyers with suppliers. Its platform primarily serves small and medium-sized enterprises across India.

INDIANB.d: Indian Bank is a state-owned public sector bank providing commercial banking and financial products to retail, agricultural, and corporate customers. It operates an extensive branch network throughout India.

INDIASHLTR.d: India Shelter Finance Corporation provides housing loans and loans against property to low and middle-income borrowers in India. It primarily serves self-employed individuals in tier-2 and tier-3 cities.

INDIGO.d: InterGlobe Aviation Limited operates scheduled passenger airline services under the brand name IndiGo across domestic and international routes. It is India's largest airline by passenger market share.

INDUSINDBK.d: IndusInd Bank provides commercial, transactional, and electronic banking services to corporate and retail customers. It operates as a private sector bank in India.

INDUSTOWER.d: Indus Towers builds, owns, and operates passive telecom infrastructure for mobile network operators in India. It is one of the largest tower infrastructure providers globally, serving major wireless telecommunications service providers.

INFY.d: Infosys provides business consulting, information technology, and outsourcing services to clients worldwide. It is one of India's largest software services exporters.

INGERRAND.d: Ingersoll Rand India manufactures air compressors and provides related servicing solutions for general manufacturing, automotive, and process industries.

INNOVACAP.d: Innova Captab Limited provides contract development and manufacturing services for pharmaceutical products. It supplies branded formulations and generic medicines to domestic and international markets.

INOXGREEN.d: Inox Green Energy Services Limited provides long-term operations and maintenance services for wind turbine generators. It serves renewable energy generators and independent power producers across India.

INOXINDIA.d: INOX India Limited manufactures cryogenic equipment including storage tanks and industrial gas systems. It serves global customers across industrial, healthcare, and energy sectors.

INOXWIND.d: Inox Wind manufactures wind turbine generators and provides related services including wind farm development, erection, and maintenance. Its customers are independent power producers, utilities, and corporate clients in the renewable energy sector.

IOB.d: Indian Overseas Bank provides retail banking, corporate banking, and financial services across India. It is a state-owned public sector bank.

IOC.d: Indian Oil Corporation Limited refines, transports, and markets petroleum products, natural gas, and petrochemicals. It is a state-owned enterprise and India's largest commercial oil company.

IOLCP.d: IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures bulk drugs, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and specialty chemicals. Its key pharmaceutical products include ibuprofen and pain management intermediates supplied to global markets.

IPCALAB.d: IPCA Laboratories manufactures and markets a wide range of pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients. It serves domestic and international healthcare markets.

IRB.d: IRB Infrastructure Developers builds and operates roads, highways, and transport infrastructure on a build-operate-transfer basis. It is one of India's largest private toll road developers.

IRCTC.d: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited provides railway ticketing, catering, and tourism services. It operates as a state-owned monopoly managing passenger amenities for Indian Railways.

IREDA.d: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited is a state-owned financial institution that provides term loans for renewable energy and energy efficiency projects. It primarily serves project developers across India's green energy sector.

IRFC.d: Indian Railway Finance Corporation raises financial resources from capital markets to fund the acquisition of railway assets for Indian Railways. It operates as a dedicated financing arm under state ownership.

ITC.d: ITC operates in fast-moving consumer goods, hotels, paperboards, packaging, and agri-business. It serves retail and commercial customers across India and is a diversified conglomerate.

ITDC.d: India Tourism Development Corporation Limited is a state-owned enterprise that operates hotels, restaurants, and transport services. It also provides event management and duty-free shopping services.

ITI.d: ITI Limited manufactures telecommunication equipment and defense products primarily for government agencies and telecom operators. It is a state-owned enterprise under the Ministry of Communications.
